approved_definition_context: EuclideanSpace real (Fin n) is real n-dimensional Euclidean space with its standard l2 norm, Borel structure and Euclidean Lebesgue volume. Fin n indexes coordinates from zero through n-1. WithLp.ofLp is the coordinate representation.

The orthogonal group is full real O(n), both determinant signs, with its matrix Borel structure. Measure.haarMeasure(top : TopologicalSpace.PositiveCompacts G) is canonical normalized full-group Haar probability.

Measure.restrict is restriction to the displayed set. Scalar multiplication of measures uses extended nonnegative real scalars. Measure.bind integrates the displayed measure kernel against its input measure. Measure.withDensity of a nonnegative extended-real function is the measure whose measurable-set values are its set lintegrals under the base measure.

multivariateGaussian mean m matrix C is the pushforward of canonical stdGaussian by z -> m + Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt C) z. Its covariance interpretation holds for positive semidefinite C. Matrix inverse is standard totalized matrix inverse.

Integrable is genuine real Bochner absolute integrability. The displayed integrals with real integrands are real Bochner integrals; unspecified measure is volume on the displayed Euclidean carrier. Real n/2 powers use Real.rpow and real division; natural powers have natural exponents. ENNReal.ofReal maps a real number to its nonnegative extended-real truncation. Real division/inverse are totalized at zero.

Measure.real B is the real value (Measure B).toReal. The supremum ranges over exactly the displayed real absolute event differences with measurable B. No TV abbreviation or independent supplied estimate occurs.
